info.title: TEQ Public API
info.description:
# Introduction
[comment]: <> (x-product-description-placeholder)
With the TEQ API you can integrate your system with the TEQ platform. The API is designed to be easy to use and to provide a seamless integration experience.

The TEQ API is built on HTTP and is RESTful.
It has predictable resource URLs and returns HTTP response codes to indicate errors.
It also accepts and returns JSON in the HTTP body.
Use your favorite HTTP/REST library in your programming language when using this API.
This API reference documentation contains the most commonly integrated resources.
# Authentication
The API uses OAuth2 for authentication. You will need to obtain an access token to use the API. The access token should be included in the Authorization header of each request.
You can create your own access credentials directly in the TEQ application: go to **Settings > Integrations > Public API Clients** and create a new client.
## OAuth 2.0 flow
The Authentication supports OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow
## Authentication-endpoints:
Token-endpoint: **https://auth.api.ferdia.app/oauth2/token**
# Domain-header
For all API requests an HTTP-header `domain` must be included. This header should contain the domain/company name that the API-call should be directed to.  You will receive this domain name when you sign up for the TEQ API.
# Time-Zone
The API uses the time-zone of the client of the request to calculate dates and times. The timezone should be included in the HTTP-header `Time-Zone` in the format `Continent/City` (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`).

tags.name: Trips
tags.description: Query live trip data - fetch trip lists, trip details, and the current status of trips on the road.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Create, update, and look up customers, including their addresses, contact persons, and fixed-trip pricing info.

tags.name: Customer-categories
tags.description: Manage the customer categories used to group and price customers.

tags.name: Requests
tags.description: Submit new trip requests, either for an existing customer or together with new customer details.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Create orders, add trips to existing orders, and track order and order-confirmation status.

tags.name: Capacity
tags.description: Check available vehicle capacity for a given time range and department.

tags.name: Price
tags.description: Calculate trip prices ahead of creating a request or order.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Look up the vehicle fleet available in the TEQ platform.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Look up employees and their calendar and availability entries.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Retrieve platform-level configuration, such as the available trip types.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Look up additional products and items that can be billed on trips and orders.

tags.name: Changelog
tags.description:
## 2026-10-16
- Added functionality to change an existing order (PATCH /sales/order/{orderId})
- Add support setting arrival time on trips in New Order (POST /sales/orders/{id})
- Adds CRUD endpoints for garages (list with name/departmentId filters, get by id, create, update, delete) plus an archive action, and extends the Garage schema with description, includeInNearestGarageLookup, geofence_radius, department_id and archived fields.
- Added CRUD functionality for Departments

## 2026-10-13
- Added a Changelog section to the API documentation.

## 2026-10-10
- Updated the documentation site layout to match Ferdia branding, fixed typos, and documented OAuth2 scopes for each endpoint.
- Added SEO metadata (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical/meta tags) so developer.ferdia.co is indexable by search engines.

## 2026-10-03
- Added `departmentId` to the `POST /sales/orders` request payload.

## 2026-09-24
- Added `POST /sales/price/calculateTripPrice` endpoint to calculate a trip price ahead of creating a request or order.

## 2026-08-27
- Renamed the order confirmation endpoint to `GET /sales/orders/orderConfirmation/{id}` for naming consistency.

## 2026-08-24
- Added `GET /core/products` endpoint to list products.
- Added `GET /sales/orders` endpoint to list orders, including new `OrderDetail`, `OrderCustomer`, `OrderTrip`, and `AdditionalItem` schemas.
- Promoted `POST /sales/orders/addtrip/{id}` from staging-only to production.

## 2026-08-18
- Added customer category management: `POST`/`GET /sales/customer-categories` and `GET`/`PUT /sales/customer-categories/{id}`.
- Added `GET /sales/orders/orderconfirmation/{id}` endpoint to retrieve the order confirmation PDF.

## 2026-07-15
- Added `POST /sales/orders/addtrip/{id}` endpoint (staging only) to add a trip to an existing order.

## 2026-07-02
- Added `GET /core/settings/triptypes` endpoint to list trip types.
- Added `boarding` and `disembarkation` fields to the trip payload.
- Restructured order/trip payloads: order-level fields (status, contact person, sales person, external reference) moved from the trip payload to the order payload; added `status` and `createdRows` to the order-creation response.
